birth.stop: Syracuse, a birth date reckoned backward
birth.date_confidence: reconstruction. No ancient source gives a birth year. The figure c. 287 BCE is modern arithmetic: John Tzetzes, writing in the twelfth century CE, says Archimedes died at seventy-five, and the death year 212 is secure. Month and day defaulted to 01-01. The birthplace neighborhood is not attested either; Ortygia is the customary placement of the old city.
